A '''priesthood''' based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] existed some time before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Its members worshipped the god Pakoukou, who was in fact the [[Knowledge Bank]]. The priests communed with the Knowledge Bank regularly and advised the [[King of Mon Cala/Legends|Mon Calamari king]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
